layout.short: the 1080x1920 Short scaled to 608x1080, centred at x 656
layout.fill: the Short scaled to 480 wide, centre-cropped to 480x270, gblur sigma 7, eq brightness -0.16 saturation 0.85, scaled back to 1920x1080

font: Montserrat variable (../marble-raytrace-kit/fonts, from its get_fonts.py); Black for titles, Bold / SemiBold for small text

encode.video: H.264 libx264 veryfast, 6 Mbps with maxrate 6M and bufsize 12M, yuv420p
encode.gop: -g 60 -keyint_min 60 -sc_threshold 0: a keyframe exactly every 2 s, and frame 0 is one, so every loop seam starts on a keyframe
encode.audio: AAC 192k, 48 kHz stereo (re-encoded to 128k, 44.1 kHz when streamed)

music.left_panel: MARBLE MUSIC; GUESS THE SONG + ? until reveal_s, then NOW PLAYING + title; SONG k OF n
music.right_panel: PICK YOUR MARBLE, 7 marble dots, follow it down and comment your color

ring.seed_choice: the top-scoring seed for each winning color in ../ring-escape/search.py's ranking, run with AVOID_WINNER = ""
ring.left_panel: RING ESCAPE, FIRST MARBLE OUT WINS THE CROWN, ROUND k / 8
ring.right_panel: PICK YOUR COLOR, 8 named dots, comment your pick before the round ends

spiral.audio: ../marble-spiral-loop/build/marble_bells_mix.m4a as mix.m4a (10.45 min), looped on its own

streams_sh.why: every broadcast ends before 12 hours, YouTube's limit for archiving a stream
streams_sh.ffmpeg: -re -stream_loop -1 per input, -c:v copy, AAC 128k 44.1 kHz, -t <seconds left>
streams_sh.reconnect: if ffmpeg exits early, retry after 5 s with the time that is left
streams_sh.keys: asked at the prompt (or pasted at the top); each stream needs its own key
streams_sh.upload: about 6.1 Mbps per stream at peak, so about 20 Mbps for all three
